import pandas as pd
def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep='first')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Region'])
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].str.strip().str.title()
    df = df[df['Quantity'] >= 0]
    df = df[df['Quantity'].apply(lambda x: x.is_integer())]
    return df
def answer(df):
    grouped = df.groupby('Category')['Price'].mean()
    return {k: v for k, v in grouped.items()}
